name: Court Gates (adversarial-DD-cleared idiosyncratics)
thesis: A basket of single-name situations that survived an adversarial red/blue diligence court before entry. The origin read is a consumer sub-cluster where the channel says the 'cooling' narrative is wrong and the promotional rack is the one witness for the bear side, watched weekly: if discounting deepens, demand is genuinely softening and the thesis is falsified. The rest of the names are unrelated idiosyncratic setups that cleared the same gate. Edge is name-specific mispricing that resolves on each name's own catalyst, not a shared macro factor.
